entries.title: Haimiya-senpai wa Kowakute Kawaii
entries.nativeTitle: 灰宮先輩は怖くてかわいい
entries.synopsis: At my high school, everyone fears Haimiya-senpai. With her sharp piercings, striking grey wolf-cut, and that brutally honest Kansai dialect, she has a reputation for being downright terrifying. Yet, for some mysterious reason...this intimidating upperclassman is kind and gentle only to me! The curtain rises upon this heart-fluttering romantic comedy about a terrifying-yet-sweet senpai!

entries.title: A Parallel World With a 1:39 Male to Female Ratio Is Unexpectedly Normal
entries.nativeTitle: 男女比1:39の平行世界は思いのほか普通
entries.synopsis: Satou Sou is accidentally swapped with himself in a parallel world with a male/female ratio of 1:39. He finds a kind family and lovely women at the place where he was switched. Seeing the outside of these women, he's relieved to see that the number of men and women has changed, but not much else. However, their inner lives are filled with conflicts and troubles.
